test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No Improvement'.**

Keep him at arm's length __lest you may not__ repent in the long run.
solution:
The correct answer is 'lest you should'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The error lies in the incorrect usage of modal verb **'may not'.**
 
• **'Lest'** is used to describe
